verses: Qasam hai tor ki
Aur likhi hui kitab ki
Jo jhilli kay khulay huye warq mein hai
Abad ghar ki
Aur unchi chat ki
Aur bharkaye huye samandar ki
Be-shak aap kay rab ka azab ho ker rehney wala hai
Ussay koi rokney wala nahi
Jiss din aasman tharaney lagay ga
Aur pahar chalney phirney lagen gay
Uss din jhutlanay walon ko (poori) kharabi hai
Jo apni byhoda goee mein uchal kood ker rahey hain
Jiss din woh dhakkay dey dey ker aatish jahannum ki taraf layen jayen gay
Yehi woh aatish dozakh hai jissay tum jhoot batlatay thay
(abb batao) kiya yeh jadoo hai? Ya tum dekhtay hi nahi ho
Jao dozakh mein abb tumhara sabar kerna aur na kerna tumharay liye yaksan hai tumhen faqat tumharay kiye ka badla diya jaye ga
Yaqeenan perhezgar log jannaton mein aur nematon mein hain
Jo unhen unn kay rab ney dey rakhi hain uss per khush khush hain, aur unn kay perwerdigar ney unhen jahannum kay azab say bhi bacha liya hai
Tum mazay say khatay peetay raho unn aemaal kay badlay jo tum kertay thay
Barabar bichay huye shandaar takhtay per takiey lagaye huye. Aur hum ney unn kay nikkah bari bari aankhon wali (hooron) say ker diye hain

Aur jo log eman laye aur unn ki aulad ney bhi eman mein unn ki pairwee ki hum unn ki aulad ko unn tak phoncha den gay aur unn kay amal say hum kuch kum na keren gay, her shakhs apney apney aemaal ka girwi hai
Hum unn kay liye meway marghoob gosht ki rail pail ker den gay
(khush tabaee kay sath) aik doosray say jam (sharab) ki cheena jhapta keren gay jiss sharab kay suroor mein to byhoda goee hogi na gunah
Aur unn kay ird-gird unn kay no umar ghulam chal phir rahey hun gay, goya kay woh moti thay jo dhakay rakhay thay
Aur aapas mein aik doosray ki taraf mutawajha ho ker sawal keren gay
Kahen gay kay uss say pehlay hum apney ghar walon kay darmiyan boht dara kertay thay
Pus Allah Taalaa ney hum per bara ehsan kiya aur humen tez tund garum hawaon kay azab say bacha liya
Hum uss say pehlay hi uss ki ibadat kiya kertay thay, be-shak woh mohsin aur meharban hai
To aap samjhatay rahen kyunkay aap apney rab kay fazal say na to kaahin hain na deewana
Kiya kafir yun kehtay hain kay yeh shaeer hai hum uss per zamaney kay hawadis (yani maut) ka intizar ker rahey hain
Keh dijiye! tum muntazir raho mein bhi tumharay sath intizar kerney walon mein hun
Kiya unn ki aqlen unhen yehi sikhati hain? Ya yeh log hi sirkash hain
Kiya yeh kehtay hain kay uss nabi ney (Quran) khud gharr liya hai, waqiah yeh hai kay woh eman nahi latay
Acha agar yeh sachay hain to bhala uss jaisi aik (hi) baat yeh (bhi) to ley aayen
Kiya yeh baghair kissi (peda kerney walay) kay khud khud peda hogaye hain? Ya yeh khud peda kerney walay hain?
Kiya unhon ney hi aasmano aur zamin ko peda kiya hai? Balkay)yeh yeh yaqeen na kerney walay log hain
Ya kiya unn kay pass teray rab kay khazaney hain? Ya (unn khazanon kay) yeh daroghah hain
Ya kiya unn kay pass koi seerhi hai jiss per charh ker suntay hain? (agar aisa hai) to unn ka sunnay wala koi roshan daleel paish keray
Kiya Allah ki to sab larkiyan hain aur tumharay haan larkay hain?
Kiya to unn say koi ujrat talab kerta hai kay yeh uss kay tawaan say bojhal ho rahey hain
Kiya unn kay pass ilm ghaib hai jissay yeh likh letay hain?
Kiya yeh log koi fareb kerna chahatay hain? To yaqeen kerlen kay fareb khordah kafir hi hain
Kiya Allah kay siwa unn ka koi mabood hai? (hergiz nahi) Allah Taalaa unn kay shirk say pak hai
Agar yeh log aasman kay kissi tukray ko girta hua dekh len tab bhi keh den kay yeh teh ba teh badal hai
To unhen chor dey yahan tak kay unhen uss din say sabiqa paray jiss mein yeh bey hosh ker diye jayen gay
Jiss din unhen unn ka makar kuch kaam na dey ga aur na woh madad kiye jayen gay
Be-shak zalimon kay liye uss kay alawa aur azab bhi hain. Lekin unn logon mein say aksar be-ilm hain
To apney rab kay hukum kay intizar mein sabar say kaam ley, be-shak to humari aankhon kay samney hai. Subha ko jab to uthay apney rab ki paki aur hamd biyan ker
Aur raat ko bhi uss ki tasbeeh parh aur sitaron kay doobtay waqt bhi
